---
title: "About"
---

Ethno Archive is an independent academic resource for materials related to ethnomethodology, conversation analysis, and related approaches to the study of social action.

The site collects and makes accessible lectures, seminar transcripts, working documents, bibliographic resources, and other materials that may be difficult to locate elsewhere.

Ethno Archive is not an official repository of any university, association, research group, or individual scholar. Materials are presented with information about their source and provenance whenever this is available.

Copyright and other rights remain with the respective authors, speakers, photographers, publishers, or other rights holders. Where materials are subject to restrictions on quotation, circulation, or reuse, these restrictions are indicated on the relevant pages. If you are a rights holder and believe that material on this site should be corrected, attributed differently, or removed, please get in touch: [info@ethno-archive.org](mailto:info@ethno-archive.org)

The archive is a work in progress. Additional collections, contextual information, and bibliographic documentation will be added over time.
